about: Every FILLED album hole with a readable date (of 917 filled of 1,775): coins Joseph already owns in his 33 albums. Their value today is Grok's ledger estimate per album; this gives each hole a cited price. Answer rows: {slot, price_usd, grade, url, quote}. Claude turns accepted rows into collection/prices/album_values_gemini_*.json.
grade_rule: VF-20 (album coins were pulled from circulation). When the guide lists no circulated price for that date and mint (most coins after 1964), price_usd = the face value and grade = 'face (no circulated price listed)', with the url of the guide page that shows it.
sources: https://www.pcgs.com/prices (PCGS Price Guide: the page for that exact date and mint)
https://www.ngccoin.com/price-guide/ (NGC: the page for that exact date and mint)
for Canada: the NGC world price page or the Numista entry's value table
left_out: 27 filled holes with no readable date (display coins, blank holes)
